patch_description:
Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic maximin search in barycentric coordinates. The equilateral triangle is parameterized by `(u, v)` with `u >= 0`, `v >= 0`, and `u + v <= 1`; importantly, the absolute determinant of three such coordinate pairs is exactly the triangle area normalized by the area of the enclosing equilateral triangle.

The search fixes the three extremal vertices, which are structurally useful in strong Heilbronn configurations, and evolves the remaining points using an elite-preserving stochastic search with a fixed seed. Candidate mutations are projected back to the simplex, so every returned point is guaranteed to lie within the target triangle. Selection uses the minimum normalized area plus a small lower-tail bonus, avoiding unstable configurations that improve just one bottleneck triangle while creating several nearly degenerate ones.
